name: target_pick
description: The picker: the candidates are the set bits 0 to 30 of the mask, none gives 0xff, one gives that one with no draw, two or more draw once on the stream and take the candidate of rank value mod count.

function.signature: int pick_target(int user, u32 mask, int prop, int p, int stream, int mode, int resolved, u8 *out)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: in.out says whether the caller gave an output pointer; without one the function only reports the candidate mask and draws nothing (the chain always gives one). out.out is the reported slot (255 for none), out.nDraws the number of draws.
